thread:
josh: Alert: small but reproducible spike in SSE reconnects + duplicate-charge reports after last night's auth-key rotation. :eyes:

josh: Customers in us-east seeing resume tokens rejected as expired even though token.exp > now.

maya: Yikes. Any logs?

josh: Log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-23T00:12:03Z] tenant=beta resume_token=tok_zzzz status=accepted key_id=old-key
[2026-03-23T00:12:03Z] backend_replay: seq_expected=450 seq_seen=1 -> kv_mismatch
[2026-03-23T00:12:04Z] billing: token_consumed tenant=beta token=tok_zzzz route=us-east
[2026-03-23T00:12:04Z] consumer_seen_duplicate id=evt_321
[2026-03-23T00:12:05Z] resume:reject reason=token_expired_token_ts=1700000000 token_expiry=1700003600
```

arun: token_expired but expiry in future — that smells like clock skew or key rollover semantics. Did we change signature format?

sasha: We rolled a new signing key (new-key) at 00:10UTC and removed old-key from the active set at 00:11. Rolling order was: rotate -> publish -> remove. Seems like a propagation gap to some proxies.

lina: Console shows a burst of resume_accepts followed by many 'partial replay' errors. The per-route billing panel counts the accept and then customer messages show duplicates.

josh: Hypothesis: some proxies accepted resumes signed by old-key but routed to backends expecting new shard namespace mapping, so KV replay indices don't line up. Alternatively, some edge proxies had stale key cache and accepted tokens they shouldn't.

maya: Immediate mitigation: re-enable old-key acceptance for 10m on all frontends (hotfix) and mark resumes accepted under old-key with metric `resume_key_overlap` so we can reconcile billing.

arun: We should also include key_id in the token header (JWT-style) if not present and require backend verification to check token.key_id matches backend.allowed_key_ids. Add metric `resume.signature_mismatch{key_id,region}`.

sasha: Long-term: introduce rolling key acceptance window and publish key propagation status to the console (key_propagation_ok per-region). Also add a preflight handshake at rotate time that pings frontends to confirm new-key active before removing old-key.

lina: For customers: add UI flag to filter billing by `token_key_id` and a dedupe column for events with identical event IDs. We can backfill duplicates by matching event ids for last 72h.

josh: Plan:
- hotfix: accept old-key for 10 minutes + emit resume_key_overlap (josh)
- telemetry: add resume.signature_mismatch and key_propagation_ok (maya/arun)
- console: dedupe UI + key filter (lina)
- infra: add rotate preflight + propagation check (sasha)

ops-bot: runbook/links -> https://deploy.internal/redwood/hotfixes/1713459876

maya: Canary the hotfix in us-east 5% first. If no additional duplication, expand.

arun: Also add a strict validation mode behind a flag that rejects tokens signed by key_ids not in backend.allowed_key_ids to prevent cross-topology acceptance. Default to permissive during rollout.

sasha: Will update rotation playbook to include propagation checks and a required `all-frontends:ok` signal before removing keys.

josh: I'll open the hotfix PR now and wire the metric. Pulling the logs into the thread when ready.

lina: I'll scope the console changes and start the backfill script.

maya: Thanks, keeping an eye on alerts and customer support tickets. Post any odd event IDs here.
